description: Calculates a BaZi (Four Pillars of Destiny, 八字 / 四柱推命 / 사주) chart for one person from their birth details, using FateSign's calendar engine with time zones, historical daylight saving, True Solar Time and solar-term boundaries. Returns the four pillars with hidden stems, Ten Gods, Twelve Stages, Na Yin and Shen Sha; the Five Elements balance, seasonal strength and relations; the luck cycles (Da Yun), the annual pillars of the current cycle and the monthly pillars of focus_year; the matched birthplace and time corrections; and links to FateSign pages in the requested language.

birth_date.description: Birth date as YYYY-MM-DD. With calendar=lunar this is the lunar year, month and day.

birth_place.description: Birth city and country, e.g. 'Osaka, Japan'. Used for the time zone, daylight saving and True Solar Time. Required unless timezone is given.

birth_time.description: Local clock time at birth, 24-hour HH:MM. null when the user does not know it (the hour pillar is then omitted). Do not adjust it for daylight saving or solar time.

calendar.description: Use lunar only when the user gives a Chinese lunar-calendar date.

focus_year.description: Year for the annual and monthly pillars. Defaults to the current year.

gender.description: Sets the direction of the luck cycles.

lang.description: Language of the labels in the result. Match the user's language.

lunar_leap_month.description: True when a lunar date falls in a leap month.

timezone.description: IANA time zone such as Asia/Shanghai. Only when the birthplace is unknown; True Solar Time is then not applied.

name: calculate_bazi_chart
title: Calculate a BaZi chart
